cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -1.09% · WTI +1.02% · Brent +3.63% · NatGas -3.34%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Shale & E&P is doing the heavy lifting at +3.58%.

cards.headline: Shale & E&P leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Shale & E&P at +3.58%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -2.16%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at -14.81%
cards.body: Leaders: AR +5.79%, EQNR +5.10%, OVV +4.84%, APA +4.38%, TRGP +4.37%. Laggards: EOSE -14.81%, LEU -9.34%, FLNC -9.18%, OKLO -6.56%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
